title: Create Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Search Ads
content_data:
This article explains how to create Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Search Ads.

Depending on your catalog type, you can create Automotive Search Ads for Inventory (using an Auto-Inventory catalog) or Automotive Search Ads for Models (using an Auto-Model catalog). For detailed instructions, refer to the respective articles:

- [Create Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Search Ads for Inventory](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-upgraded-smart-automotive-search-ads-for-inventory/v1.3)
- [Create Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Search Ads for Models](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-upgraded-smart-automotive-search-ads-for-models/v1.3)
